# 七个SEO GEO常见问题与ChatGPT共识策略

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-09-26 15:09（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2103743824921084359
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

大多数创业者知道自己应该做 SEO 和 GEO，但多数人并没有做。

于是他们卡在那里，一遍又一遍地问同样的问题。

也许你也有这 7 个 SEO 问题：

1) 做 SEO 最好的方式是什么？

别再想了，开始干。

先做规划：想象你在为一本书写目录，章节什么的都写出来。

然后把主题填进去。

再开始把所有内容连接起来。

用 SEO 行话来说，这叫主题地图（Topical Map）。

2) 我今天就需要客户，应该做 SEO 吗？

不，如果你已经急得不行，常规 SEO 帮不上忙。

不过，有一种做法叫“寄生 SEO”。

它的意思是，找到一个已经在你想要的关键词上获得排名的页面，然后让自己出现在那个页面上。

你可以自己在 Reddit 等地方操作，也可以付钱请人把你列入其他人的网站。

向这个领域的一些专家学习：@JespernissenSEO @Charles_SEO @ConnorShowler。

3) 我怎么知道自己的 SEO 是否真的有效？

你应该看到点击量逐月增加。

但你必须有耐心。

如果你刚开始做 SEO，可能需要 3-12 个月才能看到明显变化。

就这么简单。

4) 外链是必需的吗？

是，但没有许多人想让你相信的那么重要——他们靠这个赚钱。

不过，刚起步时，你确实需要做所谓的“基础外链”。

这些是让你的 SEO 起步的第一批外链和提及。

你也可以使用我的“Contant Assets That Work”Claude 技能，创建能够免费获得链接的内容，链接在个人简介里。

5) 我应该多重视技术 SEO？

如果网站持续更新，例如 WordPress，就应该每隔几个月审核一次。

如果网站基本是静态的，每年检查一次就够了。

但如果你专业做 SEO，甚至不用专门安排这个任务，因为你会经常检查指标。

如果你不是 SEO 专业人士，可以用这个免费工具快速审核：https://roborank.io/seo-audit

6) 我的网站持续下滑，怎样恢复？

流量下跌，是 Google 在对你说：“我们得谈谈。”

但如果没有正确诊断，很难告诉你为什么在下滑。

对于这个问题，我通常会给出以下四种回答：

A) 由于 Google 直接展示信息型内容，许多网站的内容正在被 AI 取代。因此，你要增加更多真正能带来效果的内容：商业角度、尚未得到回答的问题、与趋势相关的新内容、新闻等。

B) 如果你滥用了大规模 AI 内容发布或程序化 SEO，我建议减少页面数量。让内容更有人味，并改进整个网站的内容结构。

C) 如果你很久没有更新内容，我建议先刷新元标题、加强内部链接，并完善 Schema 数据。如果你使用 WordPress 或 Webflow，我的工具 Roborank 能帮你非常快地完成这些工作。我本人每周都会用它编辑数百个页面。

D) 如果你几乎没有外链，就要建立更多外链，方法见上文。

从某种意义上说，你不应该专注于找回已经失去的东西，而是应该给网站一个新角度，让 Google 重新发现它。

7) 我怎样才能出现在 ChatGPT 上？

你要进入共识之中。确保自己总是和竞争对手一起被列出。

确保你为品牌、服务或产品准备了完善的 FAQ。

你也可以用 Claude Code 添加更多 Schema。

能做的事情还有很多。更多信息请看 CITED 框架：https://x.com/fba/status/2021879774323314696

## 英文原文

Most entrepreneurs know they should be doing SEO and GEO, yet most of them don't.

So they are stuck and ask the same questions over and over again.

Maybe you have the same 7 SEO questions:

1) What's the best way to do SEO?

Just don't think about it and start working.

First, plan: imagine you're writing the index of a book. Chapters and all.

Then put topics inside.

Then start connecting everything.

In SEO lingo we call this a Topical Map.​

2) I need customers TODAY, should I do SEO?

No, regular SEO won't work if you're desperate.

HOWEVER, there's a thing called "Parasite SEO".

It involves taking a page already ranking for a word you want and getting listed there.

You can do on your own in places like reddit or pay someone to get you listed in private websites.

Learn from some of the experts in this field: @JespernissenSEO @Charles_SEO @ConnorShowler 

3) How do I know if my SEO is actually working?

You should see more clicks on a monthly basis.

But you've got to be patient.

If you're just getting started with SEO it can take 3-12 months to start seeing serious movement.

It's simple.

4) Are backlinks necessary?

Yes they are, but not as much as many want you to believe (they make money off of it)

But when you're getting started you certainly need to do what is called "foundational backlinks".

These are the first backlinks and mentions that get your SEO started.

Or you can also create content that gets linked for free by using my "Contant Assets That Work" Claude Skill (link in bio)

5) How much attention should I pay to Technical SEO?

If your site gets ongoing updates (e.g. Wordpress), then you should audit it every few months.

If it's mostly static, a yearly review it's enough.

But if you're doing SEO profesionally you won't even need to schedule this, as you will be checking your metrics often.

If you're not an SEO professional, you can do a quick audit using this free audit tool: https://roborank.io/seo-audit

6) My website is downtrending, how can I recover it?

A traffic drop is Google's way of saying 'we need to talk'.

But it's hard to tell you why it's downtrending without diagnosing properly.

These are four common answers I give to this question:

A) Most websites are losing content to AI due to informational content being shown by Google. So you want to add more of the content that moves the needle: Commercial angles. Questions that haven't been answered. New content related to trends. News. Etc.

B) If you've abused publishing AI content en masse or programmatic SEO, my advice is to cut your pages. Humanize your content, and improve the content structure of your site.

C) If you haven't updated your content in a long time, I recommend you to refresh your meta titles, enhance your internal linking and enhance your schema data to begin with. If you use Wordpress or Webflow, my tool Roborank can help you do this very fast (I personally edit hundreds of pages with it every week.)

D) If you have almost no backlinks, you want to create more (see above.)

IN a way, you don't want to focus on recovering what you lost, but give your site a new angle where Google rediscovers it.

7) How can I show up on ChatGPT?

You want to enter the consensus. Make sure you're always listed amongst your competitors.

Make sure you have proper FAQs about your brand, services or products.

You can also add additional schema with Claude Code.

There are many more things you can do. Check the CITED framework for more info: https://x.com/fba/status/2021879774323314696
